title: Edge
description: A relationship between two entities — a link in the knowledge graph. Stored undirected (source_id < target_id).

source.description: Entity id (the smaller of the pair).

target.description: Entity id (the larger of the pair).

label.description: Short lowercase relationship label, e.g. 'works with', 'lives in', 'appears with'.

weight.description: Number of times this labeled relationship has been observed; drives edge thickness.

last_seen.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent observation.
